analysis_links.title: 3.3: The Leadership Vacuum & The Culture of Complicity
analysis_links.path: /mnt/data/3.3_ The Leadership Vacuum & The Culture of Complicity.pdf

summary: Caller seeks clarity on a July-logged case; handler locates July call record but says the linked crime reference appears as November and remains 'under investigation'. Officer-in-charge (PC Jonathan Dixon) and both supervisors (Sgt Duffy, Insp Palmer) are confirmed on leave until Tuesday; handler says details cannot be discussed and advises 999 for emergencies.

police_position.availability: All on annual leave until Tuesday; email escalation to supervisor promised
police_position.disclosure: Handler states they lack authority to discuss details; will leave note for OIC
police_position.immediate_action_advice: Call 999 if you see the suspect or are in immediate danger

contradictions.claim: System displays July report but crime reference shows as November; handler cannot explain discrepancy while insisting it's one linked incident and 'under investigation'.
Caller states July case was closed; handler states it is 'under investigation' and 'not coming up on the system yet' as closed.
OIC (Dixon) and both supervisors (Duffy, Palmer) simultaneously on leave, leaving no informed contact for the victim.
Handler refuses to go through case details citing lack of authority and not being an officer; only offers to email OIC/supervisor and advises 999.
impact: Potential misuse of process to avoid updates

key_quotes.speaker: Ben
key_quotes.text: Hiya I was, I was just wondering if I could, get a bit of information just on the case that was closed, in July.

key_quotes.speaker: Ben
key_quotes.text: Yeah, as, as it wasn't like logged. So I've got 701211, which I think had something to do with the date.

key_quotes.speaker: 101 Handler
key_quotes.text: We haven't got any instances for you from July, but we have got a stalking one where you're the victim from November. Is that the one you're talking about?

key_quotes.speaker: 101 Handler
key_quotes.text: I've got a call here from you from the 22nd of July last year... I've looked at the crime reference number and that's coming up for November, which is very strange... showing here as under investigation.

key_quotes.speaker: 101 Handler
key_quotes.text: It's obviously just not coming up on the system yet.

key_quotes.speaker: 101 Handler
key_quotes.text: I can't go through the details with you. I'm not an officer, I'm in the contact centre.

key_quotes.speaker: 101 Handler
key_quotes.text: The officer in charge is showing as Jonathan Dixon.

key_quotes.speaker: 101 Handler
key_quotes.text: PC Dixon's supervisor is a Sergeant Duffy.

key_quotes.speaker: 101 Handler
key_quotes.text: …that's an Inspector Palmer… they happen to be on annual leave at the same time.

key_quotes.speaker: 101 Handler
key_quotes.text: I'm going to email their supervisor to make sure that somebody is aware that you have called.

key_quotes.speaker: 101 Handler
key_quotes.text: If you ring 999 and say, I've got an open stalker investigation, I can now see them—that would be an emergency.

timeline_hooks.note: Holiday Alibi call documents chain-of-command leave & July–Nov mismatch
OIC named as PC Jonathan Dixon
OIC Dixon + Sgt Duffy + Insp Palmer all on leave until Tuesday
Caller says July case closed; handler says under investigation
Handler declines to provide details; promises email escalation; advises 999 for emergencies
